title: Ten-pointed stars of the Mihrimah Sultan mosque, Üsküdar
subtitle: Mihrimah Sultan mosque, Üsküdar, Istanbul

given.O: The centre of a ten-pointed star, where two mirrors of the pattern cross.
given.A: A point to the right of O. The star’s lines touch the circle through A.

construction.note: The finished design was read from Wichmann’s MIR17 drawing of interlaced bands; the band centre lines give the tiling. One ten-pointed star with sharp points of 72° sits in each tile, and every other band runs parallel to one of its ten lines. With OA the distance from O to the star’s lines, the tile is a rectangle 2(7 + 3√5) by 4 tan 72°, and every offset from O is a + b√5 (drawing within 0.003 of OA, the accuracy of its bevelled bands). Each line is drawn through a crossing of earlier lines. The drawing gives no steps; we devised the construction.
construction.changes: The compass steps, their order and the named points are ours. The bands are drawn as their centre lines. Colours follow the shapes; his drawing has one colour for every piece but the star. No photograph was checked.

credits.source: Tiling Search, data214/MIR17: Mihrimah Sultan mosque, Üsküdar, Istanbul
credits.creator: Brian Wichmann
credits.note: Read from his finished drawing, not construction instructions. His reference is a personal communication from Miroslaw Majewski: a pattern of the Mihrimah Sultan mosque, Üsküdar, Istanbul, Turkey.

steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A. It crosses the horizontal line again at F.
Draw a vertical line through O. It crosses the circle at N.
Draw a circle with centre F through O. It crosses the first circle at Y1 and Y2. Draw a straight line through Y1 and Y2. It crosses the horizontal line at M, halfway from O to F.
Draw a circle with centre M through N. It crosses the horizontal line at R.

Draw a circle with centre A and opening from O to R. It crosses the circle at B and K. Draw circles of the same size round the circle, each centred where the last one crosses it. They mark C, D, E, G, H and J. The circle is now cut into ten.

Draw a line through A at 90° to the horizontal line. Turn it round O by 36°, nine times. These ten lines touch the circle at A, B, C and on round. Lines three apart cross at the points of the ten-pointed star.
Draw a straight line through O and B, O and C, O and D, and O and E.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a straight line through O and C, O and D, and O and E.

steps.text: The star line through C crosses the horizontal line at T. Draw a circle with centre A through F. It crosses the horizontal line at W1. Draw a circle with centre T and opening OA. It crosses the horizontal line at W2, beyond T. Draw a vertical line through W1, and one through W2. Turn each round O by 36°, nine times.
The star line through A crosses line OB at P1. Draw a line through P1 parallel to line OC. Reflect the new line in the horizontal line through O. Turn all of them round O by 180°.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a line through P1 parallel to line OC. Reflect it in the horizontal line through O.

steps.text: The horizontal line through O crosses the line through P1 at P2. The vertical line through O crosses the mirror image of the line through P1 at P3. Draw a line through P2 parallel to the star line through C. Draw a line through P3 parallel to the star line through D. Reflect the new lines in the horizontal line through O. Turn all of them round O by 180°.

Line OC crosses the line through P3 at P4. The vertical line through O crosses the line through P2 at P5. Draw a line through P4 parallel to the star line through B. Draw a line through P5 parallel to the star line through E. Reflect the new lines in the horizontal line through O. Turn all of them round O by 180°.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Line OC crosses the line through P3 at P4. The vertical line through O crosses the line through P2 at P5. Draw a line through P4 parallel to the star line through B. Reflect it in the horizontal line through O. Turn both round O by 180°. Draw a line through P5 parallel to the star line through E. Reflect it in the horizontal line through O.

steps.text: The star line through D crosses the line through P5 at P6. Line OC crosses the line through P5 at P7. Draw a line through P6 parallel to the star line through C. Draw a line through P7 parallel to the star line through B. Reflect the new lines in the horizontal line through O. Turn all of them round O by 180°.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: The star line through D crosses the line through P5 at P6. Line OC crosses the line through P5 at P7. Draw a line through P6 parallel to the star line through C. Reflect it in the horizontal line through O. Turn both round O by 180°. Draw a line through P7 parallel to the star line through B. Reflect it in the horizontal line through O.

steps.text: The W2 line turned to D crosses the mirror image of the line through P7 at P8. Draw a line through P8 parallel to the star line through B. Draw a line through O parallel to the star line through C. Reflect the new lines in the horizontal line through O. Turn all of them round O by 180°.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: The W2 line turned to D crosses the mirror image of the line through P7 at P8. Draw a line through P8 parallel to the star line through B. Reflect it in the horizontal line through O. Turn both round O by 180°. Draw only the mirror image of a line through O parallel to the star line through C.

steps.text: The line through P8 crosses the mirror image of the line through O at P9. Line OB crosses the line through P2 at P10. Draw a vertical line through P9. Draw a line through P10 parallel to line OE. Reflect the new lines in the horizontal line through O. Turn all of them round O by 180°.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: The line through P8 crosses the mirror image of the line through O at P9. Draw a vertical line through P9. Turn it round O by 180°. Draw only the mirror image of a line through P10 parallel to line OE.

steps.text: The W1 line turned to D crosses the mirror image of the line through P10 at P11. Line OC crosses the mirror image of the line through P1 at P12. Draw a vertical line through P11. Draw a line through P12 parallel to the star line through C. Reflect the new lines in the horizontal line through O. Turn all of them round O by 180°.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: The W1 line turned to D crosses the mirror image of the line through P10 at P11. Line OC crosses the mirror image of the line through P1 at P12. Draw a vertical line through P11. Turn it round O by 180°. Draw only the turn round O by 180° of a line through P12 parallel to the star line through C. Draw the turn round O by 180° of its mirror image.

steps.text: The line through P11 crosses the turned copy of the mirror image of the line through P12 at P13. Draw a line through P13 parallel to the star line through B. Reflect the new line in the horizontal line through O. Turn all of them round O by 180°.
The mirror image of the line through O crosses the line through P13 at P14. Draw a vertical line through P14. Reflect the new line in the horizontal line through O. Turn all of them round O by 180°.

The turned copy of the mirror image of the line through P12 crosses the line through P14 at P15. Draw a line through P15 parallel to the star line through B. Draw a line through P7 parallel to line OE. Reflect the new lines in the horizontal line through O. Turn all of them round O by 180°.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: The turned copy of the mirror image of the line through P12 crosses the line through P14 at P15. Draw a line through P15 parallel to the star line through B. Reflect it in the horizontal line through O. Turn both round O by 180°. Draw a line through P7 parallel to line OE. Reflect it in the horizontal line through O.

steps.text: The W1 line turned to D crosses the mirror image of the line through P7 at P16. The vertical line through O crosses the line through P7 at P17. Draw a line through P16 parallel to the star line through C. Draw a line through P17 parallel to the star line through C. Reflect the new lines in the horizontal line through O. Turn all of them round O by 180°.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: The W1 line turned to D crosses the mirror image of the line through P7 at P16. The vertical line through O crosses the line through P7 at P17. Draw a line through P16 parallel to the star line through C. Reflect it in the horizontal line through O. Turn both round O by 180°. Draw only the mirror image of a line through P17 parallel to the star line through C.

steps.text: The mirror image of the line through P8 crosses the mirror image of the line through P17 at P18. Draw a vertical line through P18. Draw a line through P10 parallel to the star line through D. Reflect the new lines in the horizontal line through O. Turn all of them round O by 180°.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: The mirror image of the line through P8 crosses the mirror image of the line through P17 at P18. Draw a vertical line through P18. Turn it round O by 180°. Draw only the turn round O by 180° of a line through P10 parallel to the star line through D. Draw the turn round O by 180° of its mirror image.

steps.text: The mirror image of the line through P8 crosses the turned copy of the line through P10 at P19. Draw a line through P19 parallel to the star line through B. Reflect the new line in the horizontal line through O. Turn all of them round O by 180°.

The W2 line turned to C crosses the horizontal line through O at V. Draw a vertical line through V. Turn it round O by 180°. The W1 line turned to E crosses the W2 line turned to B at Y. Draw a horizontal line through Y. Turn it round O by 180°. The four lines cross at N1, N2, N3 and N4, the corners of the tile.
Join N1, N2, N3 and N4 to mark the tile that repeats.

ink.text: Ink the lines picked out in orange. They close the star, the pentagons and the pieces between them.

pattern.text: Put copies of the rectangular tile side by side. A ten-pointed star sits at the centre of every tile.
